pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Arrows and thrown tridents are unsuitable: the current setting enables arrow protection, while trident damage is rejected separately. Bring a melee weapon. Fall damage is rejected too; dropping it from a height does not replace combat.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Chiseled Ancient Dripstone Shard. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
